The selection spans brands like LG, Samsung, GE, Whirlpool, KitchenAid, Maytag, and Frigidaire. Select appliance bundles qualify for up to an extra $500 off in cart. Delivery fees vary, but most appliance orders over $398 qualify for free delivery, and store pickup is also available. The deals end December 2. Shop Now at Home Depot

Features
  • 868 refrigerators listed in the Special Values section
  • French door, side-by-side, top-freezer, and bottom-freezer styles
  • Brands include Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, GE, Frigidaire, Maytag, and KitchenAid

deals.title: Metro by T-Mobile 5G Phones For All: Free w/ new line + shipping varies
deals.descriptionHtml:
FREE 5G Phones for all. With a new line on a qualifying plan on Metro by T-Mobile! Choose from the Samsung Galaxy A16 5G, Galaxy A17 5G, or moto g 2026. There's no need to bring your number and if you're already with Metro, you just need to add a line. Shop Now at Metro by T-Mobile

Features
  • Free phone with your number on the $40 Period plan
  • New numbers get a free phone on a $50/mo. or $55/mo. plan w/ AutoPay
  • No contracts and no credit checks
  • Runs on the T-Mobile network
